public_payload.normalized_proposition: If iOS 18 doesn't bring the expected users to ChatGPT, the resources OpenAI would dedicate to Apple uptime under the Service Level Agreement he speculated about will sit unused and redundant when they could be serving other demand.
conditions: if iOS 18 doesn't bring the expected users to ChatGPT
the resources depend on a Service Level Agreement he only speculated Apple likely requires

statement.excerpt: And if iOS 18 doesn’t bring the expected users to ChatGPT, those resources will sit there, unused and redundant, when they could be servicing other demand.

from_speaker: if iOS 18 doesn’t bring the expected users to ChatGPT
those resources will sit there, unused and redundant
when they could be servicing other demand
I’d also speculate that Apple likely requires some sort of Service Level Agreement
our_interpretation: Expected users means OpenAI's prior expectations for users gained through the integration.
Those resources refers to capacity reserved for Apple under the hypothesized service agreement.
The prediction requires both an adoption shortfall and such reserved capacity. A shortfall alone does not establish idle resources.
Unused and redundant means that reserved capacity remains idle despite other demand it could serve.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence establishes the adoption shortfall and Apple-reserved capacity, then shows that this capacity remained idle while suitable other demand existed.
criteria.contradiction_condition: With the antecedents established, evidence shows that the capacity served Apple demand or was reassigned to other workloads instead of remaining idle.
